name: antd Tag
summary: The antd Tag themed to the default aha-tag chip, for an app that still renders antd's Tag.
highlights: antd Tag with the aha-tag look
Colours and size in the shared base theme
lead: New UI uses <aha-tag>. An app that still renders antd's Tag gets the default aha-tag chip: the fill, label colour, size and radius come from the shared base theme, and importing tag-theme adds the one rule antd has no token for (600 weight, 6px inline padding). Two implementations, one look.

spec.label: Chip
spec.value: #F1F1F1 fill, no visible border, radius 4, 20px tall, padding 0 6

spec.label: tagCss
spec.value: importing tag-theme adds one rule: 600 weight and 6px inline padding (antd fixes the padding at 7px and has no weight token); checkable tags keep antd's own look

spec.label: Differences
spec.value: aha-tag's colour presets, bordered shape, large filter chip and close animation have no antd mapping here; use aha-tag for those

whenToUse.when: any new UI, React or Vue
an existing antd Tag call site not yet moved to aha-tag

opinion.note: Prefer <aha-tag> for new UI. This theme only stops existing antd tags from drifting (12/400 on #F5F5F5, 22px tall).
opinion.dsv3: COVERED by the leaf: <aha-tag> is the DS component. This contract only maps antd's Tag onto the same look so apps that still render it do not drift; measured against the aha-tag values.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: A composite has no framework-free element, so its paste-and-run form is a CDN-React page: React and antd load from a CDN and mount on open, using the same shared tagTheme. No build step.

codeNote: React and Vue are two vendor libraries at two Ant generations; they converge through the same theme (tagTheme). New UI uses <aha-tag>, which needs no theme.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs on the rendered CDN-React preview: a real antd v6 Tag inside a ConfigProvider bound to the shared base theme.
